parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of incomplete results depending on the order of symbols with permute=True, but introduces a non-minimal change and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change introduces a non-minimal change by adding a loop to generate signed permutations, which may not be necessary for the issue at hand.
The PR lacks sufficient tests to verify the correctness of the changes, particularly for the new logic added for signed permutations.
